## 治理元数据

- **PR 类型**: feature
- **任务 ID**: M14-005
- **风险等级**: R2
- **责任人**: @Chengyue-Lu
- **工作流目录**: docs/workstreams/chengyue-lu/M14-CURATED-RELEASE

## 范围与非目标

develop push 在同一个 CI run 中重验实际 squash parent→source 的治理；在线 observer 认证 repository、workflow、run、attempt、job、check App 和成功状态。维护者明确作出 v0.1.0 首发范围与准备决定，fresh remote protection 回读通过，当前候选将 M14-005 激活为 READY。

## 契约与权威影响

- **共享契约**: yes
- **权威、权限或数据边界**: yes

source governance 只在 develop push 使用 governance 名称，PR 事件的 inactive job 不与独立 PR governance 门禁共名。生产端绑定唯一 exact merged PR、实际 squash delta 与 reviewed/integrated tree；消费端在线绑定同源完整 CI 的最新 attempt、GitHub Actions App 15368 和 check suite，遇到缺失、重复、失败、skipped、分页不全或 rerun 竞态时 fail closed。

`source-governance.json` 是单独的审计附件。`attest` 不下载、hash 或校验它；信任来自在线 run/job/check 核验。未来 protected caller 必须自己调用在线 observer，不能凭保存的 JSON 或候选 manifest 授信。

## TASKS 状态变更

M14-005: BLOCKED → READY。只改状态，Task 定义、依赖、owner、风险和验收不变；其他 canonical Task 行不变。

## 权威依据

路诚钺于 2026-09-15 对当前任务中的具体决定回复：“确认上述 v0.1.0 范围与准备授权”。首发范围为届时冻结 develop 的完整源码、已发布 Schema、必需公开 Runtime Registry、MIT、构建元数据、公开文档和离线 no-Skill Quickstart，接受 structural/bounded 成熟度、生产 Skill Projection 为空、无 live Provider 保证且无 M5 净收益实证。此决定授权 READY 与实现/cutover 准备，最终 release PR 合并及 tag 另行批准。

2026-09-15 14:41:58 UTC fresh readback 核验 main/develop 的四层 active rulesets、branch protection 和 effective rules 一致；hard 无 bypass，required checks 绑定 App 15368/strict latest base，review 仅保留既有 Chengyue-Lu PR-only 例外。五个 canonical M 依赖在基线均 DONE。详见 `docs/workstreams/chengyue-lu/M14-CURATED-RELEASE/FIRST_RELEASE_DECISION.md`。此决定不批准本 PR 自行合并，也不构成单次审核例外。

## 验证证据

M14-005 implementation slice: 4140daa（原实现 6597830，rebase 后代码/测试/workflow 字节不变）；source-CI fixture、CLI、公开面与文档 focused 38 PASS。

修复提交 4918b34c3d8685c1a103cc329ebc9cd172469e6f：focused 38 PASS、repository 186/0/0、governance PASS（确认合法 BLOCKED → READY）；scope check 确认其他 Task 行、Task 定义、实现代码、workflow、旧档案及 primary develop 不变。新 Attempt Trace 无 BLOCK，仅保留 capture-gap warning。

最终候选 head 为 f1ee42f34b69ee1ec346e818b2170935e7c6d162；base 为 7b1323f5e9d91c304b6d5cfc89b7ea0e87f7c5ba。[最终 CI 34984632827](https://github.com/Chengyue-Lu/research-agent-workbench/actions/runs/34984632827) 与 [governance 34984634009](https://github.com/Chengyue-Lu/research-agent-workbench/actions/runs/34984634009) 全部通过：

- Python 3.11.16 / 3.13.15 full 各 1289/1289 PASS；coverage execution 1289 PASS、coverage-quality 测量子集 1263 PASS；测试回执无失败或 skip。
- 全局行覆盖率 94.74%；governance checker 行 98.21% / 分支 97.95%；source-CI observer 行 150/150、分支 18/18，均 100%。
- documentation、repository、双版本 package/compatibility 与 required test 汇总均 PASS；develop-push 专用 source job 在 PR 事件按设计 skipped，独立 PR governance 正常 PASS。
- 已下载并核验 plan / full / coverage 工件，所有回执绑定实际测试的 merge target 9c99b862b1df429ceba7a473638515c286c27499，plan ID 27c0899e743911d25d04f57794f2313d6b3e2cd98a8abc9c6f3e79520e313d57；plan digest 重算一致，实际执行 full + impact/repository coverage + package。
历史 head f662c3796ed81cff7a956bf0d284381d62a9937b 的 CI 34961312410 各 Python 1246 PASS，仅为旧候选证据，不替代本轮结果。

## Review 修复

- P1：通过具名 v0.1.0 准备决定和 fresh protection 回读闭合外部启动条件，同步 canonical READY 与派生导航。历史 BLOCKED 提交和 frozen Attempt 保持原样，不追溯改写授权时间。
- P2：明确 producer receipt 的审计作用及 `attest` 的在线信任边界；没有改变 source-CI 机制。
- 已 rebase 到 develop@7b1323f5e9d91c304b6d5cfc89b7ea0e87f7c5ba，保留 PR #81 的 M11 状态、实现和 coverage policy 变化。

## 对抗性证据

真实 Git fixture 校验实际 squash-delta 治理，拒绝错误 PR/parent/tree/metadata；API matrix 拒绝跨仓、错 workflow/SHA、PR/dispatch run、旧 attempt、伪 check/App、分页缺口与 rerun。旧绿色 develop CI 34939526577 因缺少 governance 被拒绝的历史负例保留。

## 剩余风险与后续

PR CI 不能证明本 PR 合入后的真实 protected develop push。R2 接受并合入后，先在 exact source checkout 验收在线 `attest`，另行下载 producer receipt 供审计，再推进 release-only checks/policy include 与 atomic cutover 准备。实际 cutover、source/parent freeze、projection/prospective-tree equality、双 Python 安装、公开表面、最终 release PR 和 tag/artifact/hash 仍需各自门禁与验收。

Runtime、Schema、Registry、Skill admission、release policy 与当前 dormant topology 保持原样；本次没有创建 release ref/tag、修改远端保护或操作 primary develop。Refs #57。

## 留痕

原实现档案：`work/M14-005/A-20260915-003/INDEX.yaml`，保持冻结。本轮修复档案：`work/M14-005/A-20260915-004/INDEX.yaml`，保存 review、具名决定转录、fresh protection 回读、rebase 和验证证据；最终 head 托管 CI 以本 PR 回执为准。

comments.body:
Review follow-up for exact head `f662c3796ed81cff7a956bf0d284381d62a9937b`.

Substantive implementation verdict: **PASS**. The source-CI producer/observer design is coherent and fail-closed: it rechecks the actual squash parent→source governance delta, binds the unique merged PR and reviewed/integrated tree, requires exact same-repository/source identity, and the live observer rejects PR/dispatch rehearsals, wrong workflow/repo/SHA, stale or mixed attempts, duplicate/missing/skipped/failed jobs, foreign same-name checks, non-GitHub-Actions app evidence, incomplete pagination and rerun races. PR-event source governance remains distinctly named so a skipped source job cannot shadow the independent PR governance gate. Exact-head hosted CI and governance are green.

**P1 — Task authority/state mismatch.** Canonical `M14-005` is still `BLOCKED`, and the stable development rules say implementation starts only after the exact Task is `READY`. This PR is no longer only readiness documentation or synthetic rehearsal: it adds the production develop-push `source_governance` workflow, `.github/scripts/release_source_ci.py`, tests and coverage policy for a required M14-005 acceptance slice, while the PR body explicitly keeps `M14-005` BLOCKED. That leaves shared implementation truth ahead of canonical authorization.

Preferred resolution: close the remaining external readiness gate now — fresh ruleset readback plus a named first-release decision — and transition `M14-005 BLOCKED → READY` on the current candidate before merge. The Human decision can remain narrow: identify the first-release version/scope, accept current structural/bounded maturity and known limitations (production Skill Projection empty, no live Provider guarantee, no evaluated M5 net-benefit claim), and authorize M14-005 implementation/cutover preparation without yet authorizing the final release PR/tag. If that decision is not being made yet, keep this PR unmerged or move this implementation under a separately authorized readiness/pre-implementation Task/Audit identity.

**P2 — producer receipt semantics.** `SOURCE_CI.md` says the post-merge flow should download the producer receipt and invoke `attest`, but current `attest()` live-verifies the run/job/check graph and does not download/hash or validate `source-governance.json`. This is not a trust bypass, but the documentation currently gives the receipt a stronger role than the implementation. Either bind/download/hash the receipt in the future protected caller, or explicitly state that it is an audit artifact while trust comes from the live run/job/check attestation.

No redesign of the source-CI mechanism is requested. Once M14-005 authority is activated (or this slice is moved under a valid separate identity), I do not see a substantive blocker in the source-CI implementation itself.

Review follow-up for current exact head `f1ee42f34b69ee1ec346e818b2170935e7c6d162` on base `7b1323f5e9d91c304b6d5cfc89b7ea0e87f7c5ba`.

Substantive verdict: **PASS**. The previous P1/P2 are closed, and I did not find a new P0/P1 blocker.

- **P1 closed — Task authority/state alignment.** `FIRST_RELEASE_DECISION.md` records the named `v0.1.0` preparation decision, accepted structural/bounded maturity and explicit limitations, plus a fresh remote-protection readback. Canonical `M14-005` changes only `BLOCKED -> READY`; task definition, dependencies, owner, risk and acceptance remain unchanged. The decision authorizes implementation/cutover preparation only and explicitly does not authorize this PR merge, the final release PR, or tagging.
- **P2 closed — producer receipt semantics.** `SOURCE_CI.md` now correctly states that `source-governance.json` is an audit artifact. `attest` does not download/hash/validate that artifact; trust comes from the live repository/workflow/run/attempt/job/check/App graph. Any future protected caller that consumes the artifact as machine input must separately define and verify its run/attempt/source binding, hash and contents.
- **Source-CI implementation remains accepted.** The producer still rechecks the actual squash parent->source governance delta and reviewed/integrated tree; the live observer fail-closes on wrong repo/workflow/SHA/event, stale or mixed attempts, duplicate/missing/skipped/failed jobs, foreign same-name checks, non-GitHub-Actions App evidence, incomplete pagination and rerun races.
- **Remote protection readback remains consistent.** develop/main hard layers are active with no bypass and require `governance`, `test (3.11)`, `test (3.13)` from GitHub Actions App `15368` with strict latest-base; review layers retain only the previously accepted Chengyue-Lu PR-only bypass.
- **Exact-head CI is green.** Current content CI `34984632827` and current governance runs succeed; Python 3.11/3.13 compatibility, package smoke, repository smoke, coverage and required-test aggregates all pass. PR-event source governance is skipped under its distinct inactive name by design.

Remaining gate is governance rather than implementation: there is still no current-head cross-owner approval on this candidate. The named v0.1.0 preparation decision explicitly says it is not a PR #80 merge authorization or a single-PR review exception. Therefore merge requires either fresh cross-owner R2 approval or a separately recorded exact-base/exact-head maintainer exception under DEVELOPMENT 5.4.

Post-merge sequencing must remain fail-closed: first observe the real protected `develop` push created by the squash merge, confirm the real `source_governance` job succeeded, and run live `attest` from the exact merged source checkout. Only after that source-CI chain is accepted should the next M14-005 slice proceed to release-only checks/policy include and atomic cutover preparation.

**Conclusion:** M14-005 `BLOCKED -> READY` is acceptable and the current source-CI implementation is technically accepted. No further code changes are requested for this PR.
